rule.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle must remain completely stopped in the camera view for at least 1000 ms.

assumptions: 'complete stop' interpreted as remaining still with max_speed 0.05.
No stop duration is stated; 1000 ms of continuous stillness is assumed to qualify as a stop.
No location is stated; a stop anywhere in the whole camera view is assumed to satisfy the rule, so zone 'scene' is used.
Anchor 'bottom_center' assumed to measure the vehicle's ground contact point at the wheels.

provenance.reason: No location is stated in the rule; 'scene' is the only available zone and covers the whole camera view, so a stop anywhere visible is assumed to satisfy the rule.
Rule states no duration; 1000 ms of continuous stillness assumed as minimal qualifying stop.
Vehicle touches the ground at the wheels, so bottom_center tracks the stopping position the zones were drawn for.
